entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: An angry lord who speaks of Phyrexia as an unforgiving place.

entities.name: Guff
entities.description: A character who claims to have written the oldest trick in the book.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elf leader who leads the attack on the Phyrexian stronghold.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight who discovered its mirrored hull works as a defensive weapon.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A hero confronting Yawgmoth, who accepts his destiny.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member whose likeness Gerrard rejects when speaking to Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler who arrived on Dominaria with retainers and delights in heroes defeating each other.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A man from a decayed ancestral home, serving Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A maro-sorcerer whose troops invaded Urborg and who transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who cleared a path through Phyrexia and set a bomb against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: A soldier who refuses to turn back.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: A figure whose blessings are no longer enough.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders of Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane that recoiled as Yawgmoth arrived.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An unforgiving plane.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A swampy land invaded by Multani's troops.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest transplanted by Multani to Urborg's edge.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: An airship with a mirrored hull.

entities.name: Kavu
entities.description: Creatures that emerged from ancient nests and eat Phyrexians.

events.summary: Yawgmoth and his retainers arrive on Dominaria.
events.quote: All of Dominaria recoiled as Yawgmoth and his retainers arrived.

events.summary: Freyalise clears a path through Phyrexia, buying the planeswalkers time.
events.quote: Freyalise bought the planeswalkers the time they needed by clearing a path through the misshapen hell of Phyrexia.

events.summary: Freyalise sets a bomb against Yawgmoth.
events.quote: now you will pay for your treachery.

events.summary: Multani transplants Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.
events.quote: Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

events.summary: Sisay discovers the Weatherlight's mirrored hull can be used defensively.
events.quote: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

events.summary: Crovax boasts that two fighters who fought together will die together.
events.quote: They fought together. Now they will die together.

events.summary: Crovax is nearly buried beneath his opponents.
events.quote: Crovax was nearly buried beneath the weight of his opponents.

events.summary: Eladamri gives orders to assault the stronghold.
events.quote: Now the stronghold will know defeat.
Don't mourn for me. This is my destiny.

events.summary: Kavu emerge from their ancient nests.
events.quote: When the kavu emerged from their ancient nests
